ownership_review.decision: Move complete files and their inherent/trait implementations together. Do not split structs into declaration and methods files just to shorten paths.
Retain all nine existing files and canonical paths unchanged; session/request/response owners stay with their implementations.

verification.rs -> verification/mod.rs is mechanical ownership relocation only. Its 4528-line warning remains until the separately planned coherent verifier/plan/output extraction; do not claim line-limit debt resolved.

sequence/analysis.rs retains the complete existing bounded analysis module, including its current PCR/restriction functions. Relocation does not arbitrarily fragment these algorithms; later reviewed ownership extraction may move complete algorithms to cloning domains.
Keep 2729-line derivation owner intact under material/derivation/mod.rs. Co-locate preview declarations, revisions and methods during a separate cohesive extraction, not scattered impl fragments.

run_material_capsule currently has private root module but public API reexported through run_material. New material::capsule is the canonical public owner; remove the old run_material reexport list and update all callers directly.

Existing additional PIR/GDE/SELEX parsers are a distinct codec family, not newer versions of the main exchange format. profiles and pir_gde_selex names replace vague exchange_more. ExportOptions keeps one canonical owner in profiles; remove its existing reexport from the additional codecs and import the canonical owner directly.

Retain original Collagene XML and XDNA support and source-byte fidelity. External formats are product functionality, not internal compatibility scaffolding. existing mixed legacy_formats owner remains whole as formats::original; its GCG path remains in sequence::gcg.

pcr source, Golden Gate domestication rounds and overlap-extension execution use pub(crate) only if cross-domain callers need access; do not expose as public product API. Annotation GTF remains private to annotations.

Do not copy existing canonical collagene-model/topo/recombination/etc algorithms into new core subtrees. Existing explicit crate integrations are reviewed separately; this move manifest introduces no replacement aliases.

integration_requirements: Refresh source hashes before execution; reject changed files and regenerate affected plan entries rather than overwrite concurrent work.
Update use paths, qualified paths, macros, public schema paths, tests, benchmarks/examples, MCP/web/desktop/library consumers, fixtures and documentation together.

Apply module-path replacements as one syntax-aware mapping against original resolved paths, most-specific source owner first. Do not sequentially rewrite already-rewritten destination paths when an old root name overlaps a new namespace (formats, alignment, chemistry, tracks).
New module declarations must expose current owners with minimum required visibility; no transitional aliases.
Keep byte enums, schema versions, resource bounds and scientific behavior unchanged for this mechanical move batch.
Nested private and inline modules move with their complete owners. annotation_formats/gtf.rs moves with its parent and retains private mod gtf declaration.
Do not compile each worker patch; integrate shared lib declarations and imports once, then focused native/WASM validation as instructed by repository rules.
Before claiming completion, recompute all physical Rust directory/file limits and verify discovery/coverage of the already regrouped integration tests.
